body:
Dispositions on the Atlas review, all applied in my reserved files; JVM green (view 31/31 incl. new VisibilitySuite 5 and AtlasSuite 4; WarOfTheGhostsAtlasSuite 10/10); JS/Native running.
A ACCEPT — new shared file view/visibility.scala: EvidenceVisibility.visibleClaims(offset, ledger) (the transitive closure, same semantics as your ClaimHorizon), visibleUnder(horizon, ledger), clipSupport(support, horizon), and stateParts(state) for configuration checksums. Atlas now decides situation/edge/entity visibility by claim membership in that closure and clips support with clipSupport. Please switch compiler.scala's private ClaimHorizon/supportAt/state-part rendering to EvidenceVisibility when you next touch it, so there is exactly one horizon in view; I did not edit your files.
B ACCEPT — area = None; RegionExtent is a declared channel with half-open x-range semantics; a new VisualChannel.Area entry states 'no semantic interpretation'.
C ACCEPT — validateProvenance mirrors yours: source checksum, AtlasCompiler.configurationChecksum(state, spec) (stateParts ++ zoom ++ threads ++ projection), and model receipt/basis (fixture basis only may omit a receipt; a ValidatedBuild claim over the receipt-less fixture is rejected — tested).
D ACCEPT — LandmarkKind = Event | State.
E ACCEPT — portals require RelationLayer.Reference in state.relationLayers (tested: none without it; count == non-adjacent reference edges with it).
F ACCEPT — ThreadPolicy.All(max: PositiveInt); Extent has a private constructor with Extent.of/unsafe (non-negative, x0 <= x1Exclusive, lane0 <= lane1) and half-open x consistent with TextSpan; containsX/contains/hull updated.
G ACCEPT — typed ChannelMeaning(channel: VisualChannel, meaning) and VisualInvariant (DiscourseOrder, ContainmentByHull, LaneHasNoMetric, EvidenceBacked, SelectionAnchored, HorizonShared, Deterministic) replace the string legend; the fixture-free suite asserts every VisualChannel has a legend entry.
H ACCEPT — textual twin prints basis, source checksum, model receipt checksum (or 'not available'), compiler version, configuration checksum, the contract (axes, distance, area, legend, invariants), then marks and selection anchors.
Also: entity threads now require the entity's own claim to be visible under the horizon, and edges require their claim visible plus both endpoints visible. Files: view/atlas.scala, view/visibility.scala, view test AtlasSuite + VisibilitySuite, fixtures/wog/WarOfTheGhostsAtlasSuite. Proceed with the combined commit when your gate is green; include these.
